messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
and my hairband broke cause i hit my head on the ceiling of the crowded bus.

output.original_text: and my hairband broke cause i hit my head on the ceiling of the crowded bus.
output.joy: and my hairband broke because I playfully bumped my head on the ceiling of the crowded bus!
output.sadness: and my hairband broke when I accidentally hit my head on the ceiling of the crowded bus.
output.fear: and my hairband snapped when I hit my head on the ceiling of the crowded bus; it scared me!
output.anger: and my hairband broke just because I hit my head on the ceiling of the crowded bus; how infuriating!
output.surprise: and my hairband broke out of nowhere when I hit my head on the ceiling of the crowded bus!
output.disgust: and my hairband broke when I hit my head on the ceiling of that awful, crowded bus.
